A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] '''tug worker''' was part of a mob that pursued the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Dorsk 82]] near [[Imthitill]] on [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. The tug worker was the one who confronted Dorsk-82 and demanded that he let them at the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was protecting.
